1 Logan Finney From: Scott Graf Sent: Friday, March 20, 2026 12:25 PM To: Logan Finney; Melissa Davlin Subject: Recap Logan/Melissa: To recap this morning’s discussion: Logan’s performance of late has not met expectations for the role and improvement is needed in order for his probationary period to be deemed successful. A number of recent examples were discussed as ways in which the expectation is not being met, including some that deal with delivery on core functions of the job and others that address issues with professionalism and statewide policies. Logan conﬁrmed that he has struggled with his performance and is attempting to develop the processes and workﬂows that will allow him to be successful in this role long term. He expressed optimism that he has made strides this week that he feels will improve his organization, eiciency and output. Logan has been provided a list of tasks/expectations that lay out what is immediately needed for him to show improvement. That list has been updated and shared via email since the meeting. Logan is required to meet regularly with Melissa so clear and immediate goals can be communicated to him. Both Melissa and Scott will continue evaluating his performance in an attempt to resolve recent issues. The hope is that Logan can meet the expectations associated with a producer/writer. Thank you all. Your time and attention are very much appreciated. Logan, we are rooting for you. -Scott SCOTT GRAF | DIRECTOR OF CONTENT AND OPERATIONS PHONE: (208) 373-7306 | MOBILE: (704) 516-4302 1455 N. ORCHARD STREET, BOISE, IDAHO 83706
